sharp_residual: lawful search motion exists, but observed motion is sterile with respect to target coverage and component joining

rivals.DISTANCE_SURROGATE: successors move under the current structural metric while preserving target-subterm coverage; the search objective is rewarding motion that is irrelevant to closure
rivals.COMPOSITION_INTERFACE: individual successors acquire complementary target-relevant structure, but no jointly compatible pair can compose those gains into a bridge
rivals.OPERATOR_COVERAGE_INVARIANT: the entire lawful target-narrowing successor family preserves the same missing-target coordinates, so the current constructor family cannot enter the required target-coverage directions
rivals.CURRENT_FRAME_ADEQUATE: at least one successor directly improves exact target-subterm coverage or a compatible successor pair jointly covers a previously missing target coordinate

decision_table.DISTANCE_SURROGATE: some successors improve structural distance but no successor or successor pair improves exact target coverage
decision_table.COMPOSITION_INTERFACE: successors improve complementary target coverage but no compatible pair realizes the union needed for a bridge
decision_table.OPERATOR_COVERAGE_INVARIANT: all successors preserve the source target-coverage signature and no pair improves it
decision_table.CURRENT_FRAME_ADEQUATE: a successor or compatible pair improves target coverage under the frozen constructor

scientific_rule: This gate diagnoses why the 36 already-lawful successors are sterile. It must not synthesize or promote a new constructor. Mechanism selection occurs only after this decision.
